recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: karl the fog swallowing twin peaks at late-summer dusk
embedded databases migrating to the cloud
new model architectures chasing the cheapest token
a skeptic's first encounter with a language server
marine layer trapping august heat above the bay
agents waiting to be spun up from a pocket screen

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Pilot a tiny ferry through Karl the fog — swipe between lanes to collect visibility pings before the fog wall seals the route shut.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each 45-second run peels back another slice of the skyline hidden beneath the fog.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Fog banks narrow the lanes and ghost buoys drift into your path.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: monochrome fog with neon pier lights bleeding through

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Chain iOS-style shortcut tiles on a phone screen to deploy agents before sunrise — tap the sequence in rhythm as tasks stack up overnight.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: One perfect chain ships the build before the sun crests the horizon.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: More tasks spawn mid-chain and shortcut windows shrink each round.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: widget paper cutout with soft sunrise gradient bleed

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Drag syntax tokens off a conveyor into the right linter bins while a grumpy language server mutters corrections — clear the file before the rage meter maxes.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Survive one file's worth of tokens in under a minute.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: New token types appear and the conveyor speeds up as the linter gets louder.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: CRT terminal green on amber with scanline flicker

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick query fragments into a duck-shaped database pool — merge matching rows into blooms before the cloud vacuum sucks them away.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Each successful merge blooms a tiny data visualization on a one-screen pond.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Tables multiply and the cloud vacuum widens its pull radius.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor data blooms on rippling ink-wash water
